Behind every great flight are people who keep the airplane ready for it. 🔧✈️

Cascade Warbirds has expanded its scholarship support to include aspiring aircraft mechanics—and its first recipient is already working toward her Airframe and Powerplant certificates.

Kloe Manderville, a student at Big Bend Community College in Moses Lake, Washington, was recommended by her faculty in collaboration with the organization’s A&P scholarship chair, according to an October 13 General Aviation News report.

The new initiative supports students at Big Bend and Clover Park Technical College in Washington. Cascade Warbirds works with the schools’ foundations to identify students progressing well through their studies.

It’s a welcome investment in another route into aviation: the hands-on skills that help keep aircraft flying.

Here’s to Kloe, future A&Ps and the people helping them get started. 💚
